meta.title: Notifications
meta.description: Play sounds and show system popups when a conversation finishes, stops with an error, asks a question, or waits for your approval, including while the DSH window is in the background. Click a notification to open its conversation. Enable it in Plugins, then choose each event's sound and popup mode in its card on the Plugins page. System popups need the Windows desktop app, or a browser on an HTTPS page; a suspended browser tab may miss them, and there is no offline push.
